summary: One entry per version of each component of the set view, written by scripts/write-units.mjs from component.json x-history (kind, consumer note, evidence) and the version's migration entry (changes). Former public names are dated in each component's aliases.json.

entries.consumer: New: layout="cards" draws sf-view-cards over the window {page, per_page: 24} (records, total, has_next); a press on a card opens the record card beside the list. Nothing changes for a table or a board.
entries.summary: The cards layout (owner decisions C297, C306, CD-1..CD-8, round/view-cards; 1.18.0 is round/view-r3's): the layout registry holds cards -> sf-view-cards, drawn in the content slot with no page row (its «Показать ещё» is under the grid); the query carries window {page, per_page: 24}; «Показать ещё» (sf-view-cards-more) continues the list as Show more does; a card's open goes the way a row's does (the record card beside the list, C305, its card marked current and focused again on close); the selection and the host's bulk actions go to the cards' bar; the data state and why a list is empty go to the cards (sf-empty-state); the first paint holds a grid of cards. The wiring is view/js/cards.js.

entries.consumer: Nothing changes for a host that writes none of the new settings. New: head="list" (the list head, C297, C299-C301), layout="board" / kanban (sf-view-board over the lane window, C298, C304; lane sums come in a second query.change with reason lane-sums), recordBeside(id, direction) and record-card (the record card beside the list, C305 (4)); the phone first paint of a selectable view holds the list's page box (C296). One number above the round's branches (1.15.0 head, 1.15.1 table, 1.16.0 board and card).
entries.summary: View round 2 (C296, VT-2): the first paint of a selectable view on a phone holds the page box sf-view-table 1.24.0 draws over its list of records. (round/view-r2-table, was 1.15.1) List head (head="list"; owner decisions C297, C299, C300, C301; view round 2 LH-1..LH-10): a title row (name and count, views, display kind on sf-segmented, «Настроить вид», list menu by describe().permissions) and a head row (Фильтр + bookmark, filter fields as joined sf-button + sf-button-icon, Очистить, search up to 20rem, Создать split) drawn by the view from SIMAI Framework parts; windows are sf-popover on a desktop and an sf-drawer bottom sheet on a phone; the field window is the pair's filter template (SF.fieldRenderers.renderFilterField). The table draws no toolbar and no head gear under it. Draft intents of the list head study (section 7) through the same port. Without head="list" nothing changes. (round/view-r2-head, was 1.15.0) The layout registry (owner decision C298, BD-1): layout="board" (alias kanban) draws sf-view-board in the content slot, with no page row; a name outside the registry warns once (it drew the table silently) and still draws the table. The board's first paint holds lanes of a head and cards, not a table (BD-2). A board's query carries window {lanes, per_lane} (BD-4); the answer's lanes, board.moves and board.order_field go to the board; a move is record.set of the lane field, «Показать ещё» a query.change with window.lane. (round/view-r2-board, was 1.16.0) Record card round 2 (C305 (4), RC-5): recordBeside(id, direction) answers the next or the previous record id in the order the view shows (null at the ends or for an id it does not show), so a page that opened a record card from the view steps it with Alt+Down / Alt+Up. Nothing to change for a host. (round/view-r2-card, was 1.16.0) View round 2 merge: record-card names an sf-view-properties panel of the page; a record opened from the table, the list or the board then opens in it beside the list (the view marks itself data-sf-drawer-dock-host when the page marked nothing), its steps go to recordBeside (the board's order is its lanes'), its close gives the focus back to the row; without record-card the host's record.open as before. The board's lane window asks totals ["count"] with the cards; the money sums are a second query.change (reason lane-sums, per_lane 0, totals of layouts.board) after the board is drawn, their line held meanwhile (sf-view-board sums-pending, setLaneTotals).

entries.consumer: Nothing breaks: every former setting and name keeps working until 2027-01-01. A host that wants the new contract passes total (the count under the filter), sort="key:dir", totals {page, all} for the columns marked total, listens to sf-view-table-open, and moves the toolbar, paging and group actions of a table standing alone to sf-view, sf-pagination and sf-bulk-actions (C295, C296). entries.summary: C296 (view round 2, VT-1..VT-18): the table draws columns and rows. The column head menu is sort, pin, hide and «Все колонки» (then the width entries); the columns window is the sf-settings panel at the gear without the table's full-screen portal (VT-12). Short fields (choice, a person with options, date, number, money) edit at the cell on a double press or F2 when inline-edit is on: a SIMAI Framework menu or a popover with the field of its type, emitting cell-set. A totals row at the foot from the host's totals (columns[].total). New: total (aria-rowcount, «all N»), sort="key:dir", the open event {id, newTab}, scrollToRow, the empty and error slots, eight public --sf-view-table-* variables (the --sf-table-* names stay until 2027-01-01). aria-selected and aria-multiselectable (VT-4); a title without an address is a button, not href="#" (VT-9); hover at the 8 % state (VT-7); a status badge is at most the row less 8 and takes its option's scheme (VT-8, VT-18); the width grip is a 24 zone (VT-10); air under the empty-state action (VT-11); numbers in the page language (VT-14); head cells never wrap letter by letter (VT-15); the phone list after C259 with one Tab stop (VT-2, VT-3). The toolbar, search, filter, templates, create, layout switch, pagin and setBulkActions are dated former settings until 2027-01-01 (VT-13, noted in SF.deprecations on a table standing alone); where the pair carries sf-bulk-actions a table standing alone places that bar after its rows, and where the pair carries SF.fieldRenderers.dateFilter the table reads date filters through it (C293 DF-1, DF-4, DF-6).

entries.summary: C106: the gear's window is SIMAI Framework sf-settings look="panel" (sf-settings 1.6.3), not sf-menu-context tabs with rows drawn by the table. «Поля» is its fields list -- a column shown or not (the theme's light fill and a check at the end), its order (the handle at the start, a drag or Alt+arrows, the position said), pinned on top (the Framework pin button), the panel's search -- and «Вид» its density choice (the fill alone) and switches (lines, one line, the held head, «Для всех моих таблиц» after a line). Every change applies at once as before (save {kind: columns} with reason column-visibility, column-pin or column-order; view-change); «Сбросить» puts the fields back as the window opened with them or the view to its defaults, by the tab it stands on; the window reopens on the tab it was closed on. The panel takes the gear's density (C22): the hand-set 1/2 handles and pins are gone, a size is passed only when the host wrote one; on a phone it is the bottom sheet (C106 (8), C157 (5)). The host labels column-move-label, pin-column-label, unpin-column-label, column-search-placeholder and column-search-empty-text are no longer read by the gear: sf-settings speaks its own words in the page language. The filter window keeps its tabs (its templates need what sf-settings does not offer).

entries.consumer: New settings edit, history, modal; events step, history; methods openHistory, editField, step; port intents record.history (capability record-history; sealed fields said, not drawn) with the adapter SfPropertyView.historyFromRevisions and record.neighbours (capability record-neighbours); a save refused revision_moved reads as a conflict; a panel docks beside a list marked data-sf-drawer-dock-host from 64rem (modal="true" keeps the scrim); closing over unsaved entries asks in the card first; seven public --sf-view-properties-* variables, --sf-property-view--sections-width a former name until 2027-01-01.
entries.summary: C305 (1), RC-1: edit = group | group+quick | none (group+quick where the host allows editing). A group edits in sf-form (label above in the panel, beside in the full screen; Save first, a quiet Cancel); a group with a field sf-form 1.3 cannot edit (pickers, uploads, sets) keeps the card's own form. A short field (choice, date, time, yes/no, number) edits in a window at its value and saves one value through group.save. «Изменить всё» in the menu; a press on a long field's value opens its group with the focus on it (VP-19, VP-21); edited fields take the group's width (VP-27). C305 (2), RC-3: history = auto | off. «История изменений» in the menu opens a level of the same panel (C289 head: back line, title, menu, close) with sf-list-timeline by day, newest first, before and after drawn by the field's template, «Показать ещё», «Только изменения полей» / «Все события» in its menu. New port intent record.history {record_id, collection, cursor, kinds, limit} for a host that announces record-history (pages of 20, 50 at most); a field the reader may not see comes as {field, label, sealed: true} and is said as «Значение скрыто», never drawn; SfPropertyView.historyFromRevisions builds the answer from stored revisions. C305 (4): a host that announces record-neighbours names the next and the previous record over its current view (record.neighbours, answered {listed, previous: {record_id}, next: {record_id}}); the step carries it as next_record_id and the card opens it. A save the host refuses with revision_moved (the revision moved, nothing written) is a conflict: the card says so, keeps what was typed and reads the record again. C305 (3), RC-4: the full screen keeps the section column (sf-menu until sf-tabs vertical places its box, VP-26), fields in two columns, the history as a 24rem column from 80rem (VP-22). C305 (4), RC-5: from 64rem the panel docks beside a list marked data-sf-drawer-dock-host (no scrim, the list usable); modal="true" keeps the scrim (VP-23). Alt+Down / Alt+Up ask for the next or the previous record (sf-view-properties-step); the focus stays in the panel. C159 (6): closing, stepping or opening another record over unsaved entries asks in the card first (sf-confirm: «Закрыть без сохранения» / «Вернуться к правке»). RC-6: seven public variables --sf-view-properties-label-width, -row-gap, -group-gap, -sections-width, -side-width, -current-background-color, -saved-background-color; --sf-property-view--sections-width is a former name until 2027-01-01. Every new word is in the language files (C282). RC-7, VP-29: the quick windows draw nothing before sf-popover is defined (no shift at the first paint).

entries.consumer: panel-width is a former name until 2027-01-01, mapped to the nearest drawer step with a console notice; sections-as is read by an inline view only; a page needs no defineFieldsOf before mounting the card.
entries.summary: C289 (1), (5), R250: the sections are laid out by width, not by a setting: a panel shows them as an underline sf-tabs line under the head (overflow more, «Ещё (n)»); a panel of size full and a wide inline view keep the section column at the start; on a phone they are an sf-list of rows, each opening its section with «←». sections-as applies to an inline view only. C289 (2), C157 (2): the panel is drawn at a step of the sf-drawer ladder (1/2, 1, 2) or full and never grows; panel-width is a dated former name until 2027-01-01, mapped to the nearest step with a console notice and an SF.deprecations entry. C289 (3), (6), R254: «Удалить» is the last row of the head's «⋯» menu, with «Копировать ссылку» and «Открыть на всю страницу»; a record to read has no foot, and nothing stands on the drawer's edge outside the panel. C289 (4), R252: a record to read is an sf-list-description: the label beside the value on one row, each group a heading of the list, «Изменить» in the group's heading. C289 (6): the head is one row of the drawer's control height; a record opened from another shows «← <record>» above its title as the drawer's back line (sf-drawer-back), which returns to the previous record. C289 (6): a panel the page gave no panel-label is headed by the record's name, record.label or record.title (the reference host and most pages send title); it showed the record id. The back line and the drawer's accessible name read the same name. C289 (7), C182: Save is never disabled; a Save over empty required fields or entries that are not values is refused with the message under each field and, for two or more, a summary with a link per field; a host's confirmation is asked in place with sf-confirm. C289 (8), (9), (10): the first paint keeps its boxes (no layout shift when the record comes); value buttons are 24px high at least on a phone (--sf-hit--min); the view asks the Loader for every tag it draws, so a page needs no defineFieldsOf or own defines.

entries.summary: In its panel (VP-5, VP-8 of the 2026-11-16 re-check; C157 (3), C157 (7) = C159 (4), (5)): (1) the title reads the window title step the drawer's panel publishes, --sf-drawer--title-size / --sf-drawer--title-height (sf-drawer 1.16.4), before the h4 role: the head stands inside the drawer's body, where sf-drawer 1.16.0 moves the heading roles down for the content, and the title drew 16/18 (a phone 14/16) instead of 20/24 (16). --sf-property-view--title-* still come first; with no drawer, or a drawer before 1.16.4, the h4 role as before. (2) On a phone (below 48rem) Save (or Create) and Cancel in the foot share the row in equal halves, 8 apart, the main one first; what else the bar holds wraps under them. The desktop foot is unchanged. Markup, settings, events and the host port unchanged.

entries.consumer: New: sums-pending holds the lane heads' sum line while the sums come in a request after the cards; setLaneTotals([{value, totals}]) takes them. Nothing to change for a host that answers sums with the cards.
entries.summary: Lane sums after the cards (view round 2 merge, agreed with Larena): sums-pending (set by sf-view while it asks the sums in a second request) holds the sum line of every lane head, so nothing grows when they come; setLaneTotals([{value, totals}]) merges the answered totals into the lanes without touching their cards or cursors.

entries.consumer: New: sf-view layout="board" (or Larena's kanban) draws it; a host answers the lane window (lanes, per_lane) and settles moves.
entries.summary: New: the board layout (owner decisions C298, C304): lanes by one field from the host's lane window, cards with up to four fields in the «Кратко» place, moves as a change of the lane field the host settles (settleMove), «Показать ещё» per lane (appendLane), soft limits, folded and hidden lanes, one lane per screen on a phone, one Tab stop with the arrows inside.

entries.consumer: Nothing to change. A number in the first «Кратко» column stays at the column's start; only the second column ends numbers, dates and files, as the accepted prototype does (VC-1, DEV's acceptance of the cards). The same change round/view-r4 numbers 1.0.1.
entries.summary: DEV's acceptance return VC-1 (round/view-cards): fieldAlign(field, index) answers end only for a numeric field in the second column (odd index); the template passes the index and marks numbers data-numeric for tabular digits. The same code as round/view-r4's 1.0.1; numbered above it.

entries.consumer: New: sf-view layout="cards" draws it, where the author turned cards on (C297); a host answers the window {page, per_page: 24} with {records, total, has_next}.
entries.summary: New: the cards layout (owner decisions C297, C306): records as .sf-card in a grid whose columns follow its width (sizes S, M, L), a cover in a frame of one ratio drawn by the layout (cover or contain, lazy), the title in two lines and up to four fields in the «Кратко» place, «Показать ещё» over the window {page, per_page: 24}, one Tab stop with the arrows by rows, a selection for sf-bulk-actions, empty states by sf-empty-state.
